planets.name: WASP-79 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Montuno with a 3.66-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-79 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Montuno. Its orbit and size follow Gressier et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname GRESSIER_ET_AL__2023): disc_year 2012, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.66239163, pl_radj 1.53, pl_bmassj 0.85

quotes.title: WASP-79
quotes.card: It hosts one known exoplanet, WASP-79b.
